definition: to be present at an event and take part
description: A work meeting in a bright office with brick walls and tall windows. A young woman in a bright blue blazer and cream trousers stands at the head of a long wooden table, raises a pen and smiles, then sits down and draws on large building plans unrolled on the table. A young man in a denim shirt and a young woman in a lilac cardigan lean over the plans with her. Open notebooks, paper cups and a glass water jug stand around them under black wire pendant lamps.
